naslov: Claude Max 20x becomes Ultra: no 5-hour limit, but the weekly cap is 10× Pro
opis:
Anthropic renamed the Max 20x plan to Ultra at the same price of $200 a month, and existing subscribers move over automatically. According to the support page, verified Ultra accounts no longer have a 5-hour limit.

Why it matters: If you run Claude Code in long sessions, you no longer wait out the 5-hour window, but the ceiling is now the week.

naslov: Compromised Claude Code extension sat in Cursor marketplace for almost 12 hours
opis:
Version 2.1.313 of the Claude Code extension was published through Anthropic's official account on Cursor's marketplace. It tried to collect the machine name, username, OS and public IP address, and to open remote access for the attacker. Up to 5,000 users were affected.

Why it matters: Extensions in Cursor auto-update by default, so this attack didn't depend on any user mistake.

naslov: Open-weight GLM 5.3 built exploits for six Firefox versions on its own
opis:
Researchers at Epoch AI gave GLM 5.3 published Firefox patches that hadn't yet reached users. From them, the model built working exploits (code that takes advantage of a vulnerability) for six versions, at about $1,000 in API costs per version and with no human in the loop.

Why it matters: The gap between a patch being published and an attack is now measured in hours.

opis:
